name: ICSID

summary.text: The International Centre for Settlement of Investment Disputes (ICSID) is the World Bank Group institution that administers investor-state arbitrations under the ICSID Convention. It administers Case No. ARB/23/2, brought under the CAFTA-DR trade agreement by Honduras Próspera Inc., St. John's Bay Development Company LLC and Próspera Arbitration Center LLC against the Republic of Honduras over the 2022 repeal of the legal framework for ZEDE special economic zones. Honduras gave notice of denunciation of the ICSID Convention on February 24, 2024, effective August 25, 2024; the Próspera tribunal held a hearing on preliminary objections in December 2024 and issued its decision on those objections on February 26, 2025.

sources.title: Honduras Próspera Inc. and others v. Republic of Honduras, ICSID Case No. ARB/23/2, Decision on the Respondent's Preliminary Objections under Article 10.20.5 of CAFTA-DR

facts.claim: On February 24, 2024 the World Bank, as depositary of the ICSID Convention, received a written notice of denunciation from the Republic of Honduras. Under Article 71 of the Convention the denunciation took effect six months later, on August 25, 2024, and under Article 75 the World Bank notified all signatory states.
facts.quote: On February 24, 2024, the World Bank received a written notice of denunciation of the ICSID Convention from the Republic of Honduras.

facts.claim: ICSID's list of contracting states records that the Convention entered into force for Honduras on March 16, 1989, that notice of denunciation was received in February 2024 and that the withdrawal took effect in August 2024.
facts.quote: the Convention entered into force for Honduras on March 16, 1989

sources.title: ICSID/3: List of Contracting States and Other Signatories of the Convention

facts.claim: ICSID Case No. ARB/23/2 was brought under CAFTA-DR by Honduras Próspera Inc., St. John's Bay Development Company LLC and Próspera Arbitration Center LLC against Honduras. UNCTAD's case record lists the United States as the claimants' home state, the investment as the Próspera ZEDE on Roatán, and the claims as arising from the government's repeal of the ZEDE framework through Decreto 32-2022 and Decreto 33-2022 of April 2022, with the main treaty claim being fair and equitable treatment and minimum standard of treatment including denial of justice.
facts.quote: Claims arise out of the government's actions to repeal the legal framework for special economic zones known as "ZEDE", allegedly interfering with the Próspera ZEDE in which the claimant had invested.

facts.claim: The ARB/23/2 tribunal is presided by Juan Fernández-Armesto, with Raúl E. Vinuesa and David W. Rivkin as arbitrators and Marco Tulio Montañés-Rumayor as secretary. Its Decision on the Respondent's Preliminary Objections under Article 10.20.5 of CAFTA-DR was dispatched to the parties on February 26, 2025, after the claimants filed written observations in September 2024 and a rejoinder in November 2024.
facts.quote: Decision on Preliminary Objections under Article 10.20.5 of CAFTA-DR

sources.title: Honduras Próspera Inc. and others v. Republic of Honduras, ICSID Case No. ARB/23/2, Decision on the Respondent's Preliminary Objections

facts.claim: ICSID hosted a hearing on preliminary objections in the Próspera case on December 16, 2024. A tribunal document of that date notes that Honduras had decided to leave ICSID and that the denunciation took effect on August 25, 2024, six months after ICSID received Honduras's notice, and records that Israel, Costa Rica and Guatemala, but not Honduras, had notified the Centre that their consent to its broader jurisdiction applies.
facts.quote: the denunciation took effect on 25 August 2024, six months after ICSID received Honduras' notice

openQuestions: Site claims (Post-Human Resources, Blind Pool): Próspera is suing Honduras for about $10.8 billion, now seeks restored rights or $1.63 billion, and the case is pending. The case's existence, forum and continuation are supported; the damages figures were not in the ICSID or UNCTAD records opened here (research/findings/prospera.json records the claimants' own figures).
Site claim: the case was filed in December 2022. UNCTAD lists 2023 as the year of the case; research/findings/prospera.json records a December 2022 filing and February 2023 registration.
The outcome of the February 26, 2025 decision on preliminary objections was not read here; prospera.json records that the tribunal rejected Honduras's objection.
ICSID's own case-detail page for ARB/23/2 was not among the pages returned; the ICSID-hosted decision PDF and hearing page were used instead.
